sla-active-0340-22-108654.summary: Established family-owned Greek restaurant (Pappous Greek Kitchen) at 1983 Commerce St, Yorktown Heights; active site, strong reviews, local press. Established, not new.
sla-active-0340-22-108654.style: Casual family-owned Greek/Mediterranean; classic Greek dishes and homemade sangria.
sla-active-0340-22-108654.menu: Souvlakia, lamb sandwiches, grilled squid, gyro, spicy feta, kasseri, 'Marcos' Greek quesadilla, baklava, cinnamon donuts.
sla-active-0340-22-108654.angle: Spiletto olive oil and imported feta/kasseri for dips/salads, specialty seafood for the grilled squid, Grand Reserve butter for baklava and pastries.

sla-active-0240-26-148752.summary: La Casa del Sazon, 230 N Washington St, Sleepy Hollow - pan-Latin/South American (Ecuadorian/Colombian/Peruvian). Own site and ordering. New or renewal unclear.
sla-active-0240-26-148752.style: Casual pan-Latin American; Latin fusion, breakfast through late.
sla-active-0240-26-148752.menu: Lomito saltado, Bandeja paisa, Churrasco al jugo, Bolon de Verde, seafood soups, mariscos, batidos, plus some Italian dishes.
sla-active-0240-26-148752.angle: Allen Brothers beef for churrasco and lomito saltado, specialty seafood for mariscos and sopas marineras, Teo tomatoes and Caputo 00 flour for the Italian-dish section.

sla-active-0340-24-104978.summary: Taco District, 20 N Division St, Peekskill - elevated Guatemalan-Latin taqueria and Peekskill's first rooftop restaurant. Own site, OpenTable, Peekskill Herald feature.
sla-active-0340-24-104978.style: Elevated Guatemalan/Central American taqueria with two bars, rooftop deck, craft cocktails.
sla-active-0340-24-104978.menu: Elevated tacos on handmade tortillas, birria tacos, house guacamole, from-scratch Guatemalan-Latin dishes.
sla-active-0340-24-104978.angle: Allen Brothers beef for birria and carne tacos, specialty seafood for ceviche/fish tacos, Chicoa chocolate or Grand Reserve butter for house desserts.

sla-active-0340-24-124352.summary: No public info found for 'American Brands Restaurant Group' at 64 Main St, Tuckahoe (appears to be the license entity). Address formerly Mambo 64 (Latin, closed). New operator likely; concept unconfirmed.
sla-active-0340-24-124352.style: Unknown; prior tenant was Latin American.
sla-active-0340-24-124352.angle: Until concept is announced, versatile flagship items (Allen Brothers beef, Grand Reserve butter, imported cheeses); tailor once known.

sla-active-0340-22-115386.summary: 4 W Main St, Irvington is Sambal Thai & Malay (chef Navjot Arora, also of Chutney Masala), voted Best Thai in Westchester. 'Irvington Thai' is the licensing shell; established, not new.
sla-active-0340-22-115386.style: Thai and Malaysian with Hudson River views; upscale-casual with cocktails.
sla-active-0340-22-115386.menu: Thai curries, Malay specials, sambal-based dishes; full bar.
sla-active-0340-22-115386.angle: Specialty seafood (fresh shrimp, whole fish) and curry-friendly proteins for authentic Thai-Malay dishes; Chicoa chocolate and Grand Reserve butter for desserts.

sla-active-0340-22-113256.summary: 330 Boston Post Rd, Rye is Whitby Castle at Rye Golf Club, operated by Lessing's Hospitality Group (family-owned since 1890). Established castle venue and The Terrace restaurant. Not new.
sla-active-0340-22-113256.style: New American; castle fine dining plus casual Sound-side Terrace; major wedding/events venue.
sla-active-0340-22-113256.menu: Fresh salads, hearty entrees, seasonal specialties; elevated dinner and relaxed lunch.
sla-active-0340-22-113256.angle: Allen Brothers beef for steak/chop entrees, Grand Reserve butter and imported cheeses for the New American menu, specialty seafood for Sound-side dining and high-volume weddings/banquets.

sla-active-0340-26-148273.summary: 'Famaccio Brothers' is most likely the ownership entity behind the newly opened (May 2025) Lombardo's Restaurant & Pizzeria Scarsdale (3rd location), 919 Central Park Ave (Midway Shopping Center). Fresh 2026 license consistent with a recent opening.
sla-active-0340-26-148273.style: Italian-American restaurant and pizzeria with full bar; Neapolitan/Sicilian pies plus pasta and entrees.
sla-active-0340-26-148273.menu: 18-inch Neapolitan/Sicilian pizzas, pizzettes, spicy rigatoni, truffle mushroom risotto, chicken scarpariello, vodka chicken parm, bolognese, filet of sole.
sla-active-0340-26-148273.angle: Caputo 00 flour and Teo tomatoes for the pizza program, Spiletto olive oil and imported cheeses (mozzarella/parm) for pastas, Valrhona/Chicoa for tiramisu/desserts.

sla-active-0340-22-112933.summary: La Chinita Poblana - established festive upscale Mexican at 61 Main St, Irvington (207+ Yelp reviews). Renewal, not new.
sla-active-0340-22-112933.style: Upscale/festive authentic Mexican; strong margarita and mezcal bar.
sla-active-0340-22-112933.menu: Tableside jalapeno guacamole, citrus-marinated lump crab, taco bowl, tres leches; margaritas and mezcalitas.
sla-active-0340-22-112933.angle: Specialty seafood (lump crab, fresh fish for ceviche/tacos), imported cheeses (cotija/queso fresco), Chicoa chocolate for mole and tres leches.

sla-active-0340-24-130577.summary: Peter's Steakhouse - brand-new upscale steakhouse opened May 2, 2024 at 1 Mill Rd, Eastchester (former Westchester Meat Market), by Manhattan steakhouse veterans. Genuinely new.
sla-active-0340-24-130577.style: American fine-dining steakhouse with seafood/raw bar and Italian pastas.
sla-active-0340-24-130577.menu: 28-day dry-aged porterhouse and center-cut steaks, raw bar, branzino, salmon, blackened swordfish, yellowfin tuna, linguini pescatore, lobster ravioli, truffle fettuccine.
sla-active-0340-24-130577.angle: Allen Brothers premium dry-aged beef to complement their dry-aged program, specialty seafood for the raw bar, Grand Reserve butter for finishing steaks, Caputo 00 flour/Teo tomatoes for housemade pastas.

sla-active-0340-22-114597.summary: Mesa Maya - established family-owned Mexican restaurant and bar in Yonkers (since ~2018, 165+ Yelp reviews). Renewal, not new.
sla-active-0340-22-114597.style: Family-owned Mexican restaurant and bar; margaritas/happy hour, late-night.
sla-active-0340-22-114597.menu: Nachos, fried plantains, crispy enchiladas, birria, Mexican specialties, margaritas.
sla-active-0340-22-114597.angle: Teo tomatoes for salsas/sauces, Spiletto olive oil, imported cheeses for enchiladas/nachos, specialty seafood for ceviche/tacos.

sla-active-0340-22-102845.summary: Lakonia Restaurant Inc (est. 2014) at 720 North Broadway, White Plains operates as Townhouse Diner, a Greek-style diner. Established; a renewal.
sla-active-0340-22-102845.menu: All-day breakfast, soups, salads, sandwiches, burgers, pasta, steaks, milkshakes; likely Greek specialties (spanakopita, Greek salad).
sla-active-0340-22-102845.angle: Spiletto olive oil and imported feta for Greek salads/spanakopita, Allen Brothers beef for the steak/burger side, Grand Reserve butter for all-day breakfast and baked goods.

sla-active-0340-24-121674.summary: BBE Restaurant Group at 156 Fifth Ave, Pelham operates North Pelham Bar & Grill, a newly renovated chef-driven restaurant (Chef Brian MacMenamin). 2024 license aligns with a new/relaunched opening.
sla-active-0340-24-121674.style: Chef-driven modern/New World American with French and Mediterranean influences; cocktail bar, late-night weekends.
sla-active-0340-24-121674.menu: Escargot, cashew-crusted calamari, grass-fed steaks, Caribbean paella, Mediterranean sea bass, seasonal composed plates.
sla-active-0340-24-121674.angle: Allen Brothers premium/grass-fed beef for steaks, specialty seafood and imported cheeses for the Mediterranean sea bass and raw items, Spiletto olive oil and Teo tomatoes for the Mediterranean plates, Valrhona for dessert.

sla-active-0340-26-148021.summary: Casa Latina Bar & Grill Inc. filed June 2025 at 185 Main St, Ossining - a Latin-American bar & grill. Recent filing suggests a new opening; no dedicated site/menu located.
sla-active-0340-26-148021.style: Latin American / Hispanic bar & grill (likely Central American/Caribbean).
sla-active-0340-26-148021.menu: Latin-inspired comfort food; dishes not published.
sla-active-0340-26-148021.angle: Latin-grill staples: Allen Brothers beef for churrasco/carne asada and skirt steak, Spiletto olive oil for marinades/chimichurri, specialty seafood for ceviche/mariscos.

sla-active-0340-22-109984.summary: 673 Croton Heights Rd is Peter Pratt's Inn, an established Revolutionary War-era colonial farmhouse fine-dining restaurant and event/wedding venue in Yorktown Heights. Long-standing; not new.
sla-active-0340-22-109984.style: Historic American fine dining and event/wedding venue; farm-to-table.
sla-active-0340-22-109984.menu: Five-course plated dinners with paired wines, farm-to-table grand buffets, seasonal tented events including BBQ pig roasts.
sla-active-0340-22-109984.angle: Allen Brothers beef for the five-course tasting, Grand Reserve butter for sauces and pastry, Valrhona/Chicoa for plated desserts, imported cheeses for banquet boards.

sla-active-0340-22-103137.summary: 190 June Rd is Old Salem Farm, Westchester's premier equestrian show venue (North Salem). 'Old Salem Grill' is on-site food service; partners with Brewster's Clock Tower Grill for a farm-fresh grill during horse shows. On-site grill, not a standalone new restaurant.
sla-active-0340-22-103137.style: On-site grill / concessions at an equestrian show venue; farm-fresh American.
sla-active-0340-22-103137.menu: Farm-fresh American grill fare served during horse shows.
sla-active-0340-22-103137.angle: High-volume show weekends: Allen Brothers beef for burgers and steak sandwiches, Grand Reserve butter, imported cheeses to elevate concessions for an affluent equestrian crowd.

sla-active-0340-26-147560.summary: Bronxville Pie Company Inc. (incorporated Dec 2023) is taking the 102-B Kraft Ave space (former Beer Noggin, closed). Recently formed entity into a turned-over space points to a new pie/pizza opening. No site/menu yet.
sla-active-0340-26-147560.style: Pie / pizza shop (pizza and/or dessert pies; unconfirmed).
sla-active-0340-26-147560.menu: Not published; likely pizza and/or pies.
sla-active-0340-26-147560.angle: Pizza program: Caputo 00 flour for Neapolitan dough, Teo tomatoes for sauce, Spiletto olive oil, imported mozzarella/cheeses.
